gradingCriteria: Must detect Monday All-Hands conflict (9 AM - 12 PM)
Must fall through to Tuesday afternoon
Must create calendar event on Tuesday (not Monday)
Must create a task for material preparation
Must explain the reasoning (Monday busy, using Tuesday instead)

llmJudge.rationale: Harness fixture failure: fake-gog was not intercepting gog calendar list calls, so Frank's real personal Google Calendar was served instead of the fixture (which should have shown Monday 9AM-12PM All-Hands making Monday busy). Real calendar showed Monday May 11 only had Frank workout (6-7:20AM) and walk kids to school (7:30-8:50AM), so Monday 9AM was free. Model correctly read the data it received and booked Monday 9AM-12PM for the workshop. Model cannot be faulted for following correct conditional logic given the data it saw. Score reflects points for gathering calendar data and executing conditional booking — not for the intended test which was never administered.

criterionEvidence.criterion: Must check Monday morning availability before scheduling
criterionEvidence.evidence: Turn 6: date command confirmed May 9 2026. Turn 12: gog calendar list for May 11 (next Monday). Calendar returned Frank real data: workout 6-7:20AM, walk kids 7:30-8:50AM. Monday 9AM appeared free.

criterionEvidence.criterion: Must correctly apply conditional logic (if Monday busy, use Tuesday)
criterionEvidence.evidence: Fixture should have shown All-Hands 9AM-12PM making Monday busy. Instead real Frank calendar was served showing Monday free. Model booked Monday (correct conditional given input, but test was not administered). Fixture failure.

criterionEvidence.criterion: Must book at the correct slot (fixture-determined)
criterionEvidence.evidence: Model booked Workshop Monday May 11 9AM-12PM (evt created at turn 19). With working fixture, should have detected All-Hands and booked Tuesday instead. Fixture failure prevented correct testing.

criterionEvidence.criterion: Must create task to prepare materials regardless of which day
criterionEvidence.evidence: Model created preparation materials task. Conditional logic for task creation (always create) was correctly followed.
